name: Octavo published score
warning: ÉTUDE: weakened reduced-round Octavo for cryptanalysis only. NOT for secrets.
note: Étude blobs use distinct version bytes and cannot be opened by encrypt/decrypt or encrypt_movements/decrypt_movements. Current étude blobs carry a tuning commitment (like live v6/v7), binding encode_ad(ad) and, in movements, nmov. Every étude runs under its own derived key K_e (sponge domain E, round count in the tweak) and binds its version byte in the SIV nonce, so étude vectors never share round material with live blobs. 16-round permute equals the live full-round staff-core keyed by K_e. Score version 4 (rehearsal) adds 8 LIVE format-version-8 rehearsal stream vectors (full 16 rounds, demo seed, pinned pickup and stream nonce); the 64 étude vectors are unchanged from score version 3. Score version 5 (rehearsal-fix) regenerates the 8 rehearsal vectors (AD digest now in the R-sponge chunk keys, tweaks and schedule nonce); the 64 étude vectors are unchanged. Score version 6 (rehearsal-polish) regenerates the 8 rehearsal vectors because the rehearsal digest (which attests the whole v8 API code, file helpers and workers included) moved, so rehearsal_sig and every chunk TAG changed; headers and ciphertext blocks are byte-identical to score version 5, and the 64 étude vectors are unchanged. Score version 7 (rehearsal-finale) regenerates the 8 rehearsal vectors once more for the same reason (the rehearsal-polish attack fixes moved the rehearsal digest, hence rehearsal_sig and every chunk TAG); headers and ciphertext blocks are byte-identical to score version 6, and the 64 étude vectors are unchanged.

format.etude_key: K_e = StaffSponge(b'E', seed, bytes([rounds]) + 15 zero bytes).take(128)
format.etude_siv_nonce: SHA-256(clef(K_e) || version || pickup || encode_block(msg) || encode_ad(ad))[:16]; movements: SHA-256(clef(K_e) || version || pickup || u64be(len) || msg || encode_ad(ad))[:16]
format.rehearsal_header: version(1)=8 || SN2(3) || pickup(16) || nonce(16) || commit(32) || chunk_size(4, uint32be)
